The '''Frigid Plain''' was an icy plain located in the northernwestern part of the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Drift Hills Imperial Outpost]] was located underground at the northern edge of the plain, where it bordered the [[Clabburn Tundra]].
